ceiling_directive: Restate and prove the phase and confidence-ball results for the published consumer class, incorporating discrete pre-period outcomes, beta-weighted fitting, aggregation, and the relevant dependence structure, or prove an explicit inclusion/transport theorem from that class to the analyzed experiment.
improvement_directive: Replace the fixed sublinear pilot classification with a full-sample, cross-fitted, or multiscale calibration that handles slowly diverging face and cross-cell knot offsets, and prove uniform coverage together with conditional convergence of the normalized radius to c^*(eta,alpha) on every array in the same model class.
critique: The note proves the endpoint identity, constrained-Gaussian phase laws, and matching confidence-ball diameter order only over its exact stable-span, smooth-pre, finite-post class. The feasible sharp-calibration theorem does not cover all strata: slowly diverging face and cross-cell knot offsets remain outside its attainment result, and the open-ended question leaves only conservative globally honest rate control there. Moreover, c^*(eta,alpha) is optimal only among deterministic eta-measurable common cutoffs, not among randomized or observation-dependent radii. The claimed connection to the Zhai et al. application is not transferred because discrete pre outcomes, beta weighting, aggregation, dependence, and interpolation are explicitly outside the proved model, so the delivered result is an analogue rather than a settlement on the published consumer class.
